name: spectris
description: Spectris — guided Wi-Fi penetration-testing toolkit for authorized security assessments
author: Spectris

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "vite" "npm run electron:build && npm run electron:watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 dist-electron/main.js && electron ."
scripts.backend:freeze: cd ../backend && .venv/bin/pyinstaller --noconfirm --name wifi-backend --collect-all uvicorn --collect-all websockets --collect-all wsproto --collect-submodules app --add-data app/wordlists:app/wordlists run_server.py
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run electron:build && npm run backend:freeze && electron-builder
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run electron:build && npm run backend:freeze && electron-builder --linux AppImage
scripts.dist:packages: npm run build && npm run electron:build && npm run backend:freeze && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm

linux.synopsis: Guided Wi-Fi penetration-testing toolkit (authorized use only)
linux.description: Spectris is a premium, guided Wi-Fi penetration-testing toolkit for authorized security assessments — scan & target, handshake capture, WPS Pixie Dust, deauth, offline PSK cracking, and evil-twin captive portals, all scope-gated and audit-logged.
